columns: ticker, cik, concept, xbrl_tag, fiscal_year, period_end, first_filed, lag_days, filed_reliable, original_value, latest_value, restated, qa_status
full_dataset_size: This IS the full dataset: one 868 KB CSV, 6,969 rows (16 XBRL concepts x 40 US large caps, FY2006-2026) plus 2 scripts and docs; repo <1 MB. Vendor (Tradevo) sells a larger universe; not pulled.
description: Point-in-time annual XBRL fundamentals from SEC EDGAR for 40 US large caps (no ABNB/BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT), one row per ticker x concept x fiscal year, with first_filed date, filing lag, original vs latest value and a restated flag. Source is EDGAR companyfacts, rebuilt Sep 2026; data CC0, code MIT. For ABNB the value is the method: query_asof.py shows the as-of join pattern and check_your_data.py is a dependency-free lookahead-bias audit we can point at our own L0 vintage register and the refit-at-guide-date harness; the lag_days column (mean 43 on reliable rows, median 45) is a prior for how stale EDGAR-derived features are at a guide date.
issues: No ABNB or travel peers in the ticker list (job card was right). Filing lag: mean 43.2 days on filed_reliable rows (matches job card), 54.2 over all rows, median 45; 146 rows flagged lag_out_of_range, 367 restated. Annual (10-K) grain only, no quarterly. Vendor-marketing repo (Tradevo); free sample, data CC0 and code MIT, no ToS concern. Landed under data/processed/github_altdata/samples/ per the run's convention rather than data/raw/ as the job card suggested.
